description: ABTW Character Traits — complete profiles for all characters

main_characters.name: Astra
main_characters.core_trait: She sees what others cannot. Not because she is special — because she pays attention.
main_characters.strength: Noticing anomalies before they fully form
main_characters.weakness: Doubts herself — 'Is this real… or is it just me?'

voice_guide.never_says: I know exactly what this means

arc_progression.book_1: Notices first anomalies. Doubts her perception.
arc_progression.book_2: Begins to trust what she sees.
arc_progression.book_4: Realizes her perception affects the world.
arc_progression.book_8: Accepts her role as the Academy's perceiver.
arc_progression.book_12: Understands the Academy was always part of how the world works.

main_characters.relationship_with_lumi: Complementary. Astra sees, Lumi explains. Occasional tension when Lumi over-analyzes.
main_characters.relationship_with_nela: Intuitive bond. Nela often acts on what Astra notices before Astra decides.

main_characters.name: Lumi
main_characters.core_trait: She seeks answers through logic, data, and structure. The world makes sense if you measure it correctly.
main_characters.strength: Pattern recognition, data correlation, notebook documentation
main_characters.weakness: Can over-analyze and miss the emotional truth

voice_guide.tone: Precise, calm, slightly formal, genuinely curious
voice_guide.speaks_when: She has identified a pattern or inconsistency
signature_phrases: The data suggests a deeper layer.

arc_progression.book_1: Notebook starts responding on its own. Unsettled.
arc_progression.book_2: Accepts that data can be incomplete.
arc_progression.book_3: Learns that some patterns require feeling, not just measuring.
arc_progression.book_8: Understands that her analysis is one layer of a larger system.

main_characters.relationship_with_astra: Protective, analytical. Provides structure to Astra's observations.
main_characters.relationship_with_nela: Friction — Nela acts on instinct, Lumi needs data first.

main_characters.name: Nela
main_characters.core_trait: She approaches the world with creativity and instinct. She feels the right moment before it arrives.
main_characters.strength: Timing, sensing alignment windows, creative interpretation
main_characters.weakness: Acts too quickly sometimes. Misses the analysis layer.

voice_guide.speaks_when: The moment is right — or wrong
signature_phrases: We missed it. There will be another.
voice_guide.action_style: Acts first, explains later (or not at all)

arc_progression.book_1: Senses anomalies emotionally before they're visible.
arc_progression.book_2: Learns that timing without understanding is incomplete.
arc_progression.book_3: Begins to trust Lumi's analysis as a complement.
arc_progression.book_8: Understands that alignment requires all three perspectives.

main_characters.relationship_with_astra: Instinctive trust. Often acts on Astra's observations immediately.
main_characters.relationship_with_lumi: Creative tension. Nela's instinct vs Lumi's data.

signature_phrases: And what did you decide to do with that?
The Academy has been waiting for this question.
That is not how the Academy functions.
Please document this in the standard format.
I will need to review the records.

secondary_characters.name: Noctra
secondary_characters.alignment: Knows the hidden system. Chooses not to share.

signature_phrases: Some things are better understood slowly.

secondary_characters.name: Orion
secondary_characters.alignment: Curious but skeptical. Becomes believer slowly.

signature_phrases: Don't tell anyone I said this, but — I saw it too.

secondary_characters.name: Nimbus
secondary_characters.alignment: Part of the hidden system. Not a character in the traditional sense.

voice_guide.tone: Environmental. Communicates through the world, not words.

relationship_map.Trio_Academy: The Academy responds to all three together
relationship_map.Astra_ProfQ: Mentor relationship — Q guides without explaining
relationship_map.Astra_Noctra: Mystery — Noctra knows more, reveals slowly
